market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed hawkish pivot and 10-year yield above 5% create headwinds. Dow's worst September start since 2008 signals near-term weakness. Dollar strength pressures EM and commodities. However, AI stocks showing resilience and selective rebounds. Expect volatility in rate-sensitive sectors. Oil softening on Saudi pipeline is a partial offset. Crypto regulatory failure adds uncertainty. 1-3 month outlook: cautious, favor quality and short-duration.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle remains structurally supportive despite inflation concerns. Japan as global capital destination is a multi-year theme. Nuclear/clean energy transition accelerating. Housing shortage and consumer cost pressure create tailwinds for value and essentials. US debt sustainability is a medium-term overhang. Geopolitical fragmentation (US-Canada, Russia) adds structural risk premium. 6-12 month outlook: selective equity exposure, favor AI infrastructure, Japan, energy transition, and consumer value.
